name: Norco
description:
Buy Norco Online

Buy Norco Online. Norco is a brand name for the combination prescription drug acetaminophen/hydrocodone. It’s use to treat moderate to severe pain. Vicodin, Lorcet, and Lortab are other brand names for this combination, which is also available as a generic. Hydrocodone is a narcotic, while acetaminophen is a mild painkiller.

Uses of Norco – Buy Norco Online

Norco is a narcotic, while acetaminophen is a mild painkiller. Combined, they belong to a class of drugs called opioid analgesics, which work by blocking certain nerve cell receptors in the brain. Buy Norco online without prescription

Manufactured by Watson Pharmaceuticals, now Actavis Inc., Norco was first approved by the Food and Drug Administration in 1997.

Doctors have prescribed acetaminophen/hydrocodone “off label” for coughs and insomnia.

Norco Warnings – Buy Norco Online

As with all prescription drugs that contain acetaminophen, the FDA requires that the labels carry a “black box” warning highlighting the potential for severe liver damage, and another warning about the potential for allergic reactions. google us

Before taking Norcol, it’s important to tell your doctor about any allergies you have, not only to hydrocodone and acetaminophen, but to other narcotics, such as morphine or codeine, and whether you have liver or kidney disease.

 Buy Norco – Norco For Sale cheap and legit with worldwide delivery

Since hydrocodone can slow or stop your breathing, your doctor also needs to know about any brain disorders or head injuries, asthma, chronic disruptive pulmonary disease, sleep apnea, or seizures. Like any narcotic painkiller, hydrocodone can become addictive.

You should be candid with your doctor if you’ve had a personal history of drug or alcohol abuse.

Pregnancy and Norco

Norco is in FDA Pregnancy Category C, meaning that it’s unknown if Norco can harm a developing fetus because no adequate and well-controlled studies have been carried out in pregnant women.

Since acetaminophen and hydrocodone are excreted in breast milk, it’s best not to breastfeed while taking Norco.
